sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 4.5
sources.evidence: September 29, 2025 announcement names the model, says it is available that day, gives the claude-sonnet-4-5 alias, and describes coding, agents and computer use. Reopened October 27: the full announcement supplies capability comparisons but no nominal total or active size and no size-bearing base lineage.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact page maps claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 to the alias, lists September 29, 2025 release, 200K context, extended thinking and text/image input to text output. Deprecated September 30, 2026; scheduled Claude API retirement November 30, 2026. Fresh October 27 retrieval used the official .md endpoint after web-tool errors on HTML/Markdown; the complete current comparison/specification tables contain no total or activated parameter column.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.evidence: Methods describes transformer-based residual-stream processing. The paper states its default experimental model is Claude Sonnet 4.5, with 25 sampled layer positions reindexed to percentages. Alignment-audit examples explicitly distinguish production models from model organisms. Reopened October 27 for parameter evidence: residual dimensions remain symbolic and layer positions are normalized; J-lens sparsity levels and sampled layers do not establish total or active model size.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable, and are not provided to users. Used as general Claude weight-distribution evidence.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial service terms govern API access; section F reserves intellectual-property rights except those expressly granted.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: Explains standard PDF document input and text-plus-image processing. The general active-model statement alone is not used to establish support for the now-deprecated target; the exact Google Cloud specification supplies that link.

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Official function-calling documentation explicitly lists Claude Sonnet 4.5 with auto/none and any/tool tool-choice modes and tool-use system-prompt overhead.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded full 149-page PDF through official redirect to assets.claude.com/963373e433e489a87a10c823c52a0a013e9172dd.pdf and extracted text. Section 1.1.2 documents optional extended thinking. Training, interpretability and parameter-related passages disclose no production total or active count. Rechecked October 27 from the parent-fetched official PDF text (retrieved 10:18 UTC), including section 1.1 and all count/base/activation matches. Generic pretraining and post-training descriptions do not identify a publicly sized base; the additional thought-summary model is separately described and not a reason to reject any nominal model size.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded full later 135-page PDF through official redirect to assets.claude.com/bbd8ef16d70b7a1665f14f306ee88b53f686aa75.pdf. Reviewed exact Sonnet 4.5 comparisons, including extended-thinking discussion and capability tables, and all parameter/architecture references; no total or active production count for Sonnet 4.5 found. Rechecked October 27 from the freshly retrieved full official PDF text, including exact-name capability table rows and parameter matches. No activated-count column or sized-base mapping was found.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes
sources.evidence: September 29, 2025 entry records Sonnet 4.5 launch. April 30, 2026 entry confirms its 1M-context beta was retired: the beta header no longer works and requests above the standard 200K window error.

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Exact Sonnet-class model page lists text/image input, text output, extended thinking and function calling. Its Documents specification explicitly links Anthropic PDF support. It gives September 29, 2025 release and 200K GA context but still lists a 1M preview, unlike current Anthropic API documentation.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 - Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Exact Bedrock ID anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0; supports 200K, reasoning, text/image input and text output. Lists a September 30, 2025 provider launch and April 8, 2027 EOL, which differ from the Anthropic API lifecycle.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched and inspected the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. Sonnet 4.5 appears in SWE-bench comparisons with percentages (including 41.0), not parameter counts. No count-bearing lineage or activated-parameter table for the target was found.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27 for the exact target, parameter/count terminology and base lineage. No Sonnet 4.5 parameter disclosure or activated-count column was found; effort parameters refer to test-time computation.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. The Sonnet 4.5 mention concerns model-welfare responses, not size. No total/active count or size-bearing target lineage was found.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27 for target/count/activation/base terminology. No total or activated count for Sonnet 4.5 was found.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Sonnet 4.5 summary
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The target summary describes pretraining, subsequent post-training/fine-tuning, datasets and hardware/software, but no nominal size, active count or named publicly sized base. Performance and safety comparisons do not establish weight-sharing lineage.

sources.title: Small Models, Big Results - Fine-Tuning AI for Compliance at Strike Graph
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 only to resolve the concrete 70B+ lead. Page 3 expressly labels Sonnet 4.5 size an estimate, with no cited Anthropic count or parameter measurement. This third-party marketing estimate is not a nominal model specification.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to resolve the 440B IKP search lead. The revised research explicitly estimates coarse effective knowledge capacity rather than precise parameter counts; the Sonnet 4.5 rows leave actual parameter columns blank. Its behavioral lineage analysis is not a developer statement of a size-preserving base relationship and provides no active count.

sources.title: Elon Musk Reveals: Claude Opus Has 5T Parameters, Sonnet Has 1T Parameters
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to trace the generic 1T Sonnet lead. The April 10 report attributes a comparison to Musk about unspecified Sonnet, not exact Sonnet 4.5; it separately labels version-specific numbers as online speculation. No Anthropic nominal disclosure or active count is established.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 Pro Anthropic consult - recovered original
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 as the numeric search lead. The page labels itself a recovered model-generated consultation, explicitly says the 1T Sonnet comparison lacks Anthropic confirmation, and links the 36Kr report. Used only to follow the source chain, not as evidence of target size.

sources.title: Musk post linked by the generic Sonnet size claim
sources.evidence: Attempted October 27; web retrieval returned an internal error. Not treated as directly inspected evidence or as an exact Sonnet 4.5 specification.

name.note: Official display name maps to the exact retained snapshot and alias.

developer.note: Developer identified in the first-party announcement and original card.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the explicitly identified Claude Sonnet model line.

release_date.note: Anthropic announcement, exact specification and launch note establish public availability September 29; this is not inferred from the snapshot suffix. Bedrock lists September 30 as its provider launch.

open_weights.note: Explicit general Claude nonpublic-weight policy supports false for this Claude model; hosted availability alone is not the evidence.

license.note: Descriptive classification based on explicit nonpublic weights and commercial service terms, not an invented named weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no developer-published nominal total or explicit size-bearing base lineage in the reopened announcement/specifications/interpretability paper, original card, five later cards or transparency summary. Resolved concrete 70B+, 440B and generic 1T leads as an uncited marketing estimate, IKP knowledge-capacity estimation and an unspecified-version third-party claim. Generic post-training is not a mapping to a publicly sized base. Null reflects absent supported nominal evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated searches and later first-party comparison-table review found no nominal active count or activation convention for Sonnet 4.5. Exact-name tables give evaluation scores; effort and thinking budgets are inference controls, and J-lens sparsity/layer samples are interpretability quantities. The numeric leads provide no active specification. No total-to-active equality or dense/MoE inference is made.

architecture.note: Transformer residual-stream methods are applied directly to default model Sonnet 4.5 and production-model audits. Evidence does not establish dense/MoE routing or a true layer count; displayed layer indices are normalized.

context_window.note: Current Anthropic API context is 200K. Its 1M beta ended April 30, 2026. Google Cloud still lists a 1M preview alongside 200K GA; retain that provider discrepancy without overriding the current developer specification.

modalities.note: Exact model specification verifies text/image input and text output. Google Cloud explicitly documents PDF support for this model; PDF is a document input format processed through text and vision, not an independent sensory modality.

reasoning.note: Section 1.1.2 explicitly describes a selectable extended-thinking mode, establishing dedicated reasoning support rather than ordinary prompted chain-of-thought.

tool_call.note: Exact model row documents function calling and supported tool-choice modes.

patch.notes: Transformer architecture is supported by exact-model interpretability experiments; dense/MoE subtype and nominal total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Third-party size estimates do not establish specifications. Current Anthropic API context is 200K after the 1M beta retired April 30, 2026; Google Cloud still lists a 1M preview. PDF input denotes text/vision document processing. Anthropic release was September 29, 2025; Bedrock lists September 30. Claude API deprecation was September 30, 2026 with retirement scheduled November 30, 2026; provider lifecycle dates differ.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh original-source review, five later first-party cards, transparency data, exact-name count/lineage searches and resolution of 70B+, 440B and generic 1T numeric leads. No supported nominal count or size-bearing base relationship was found. All unrelated field assessments and existing context/lifecycle caveats are preserved.
